Test fixtures. `navbar.ftl` and `dispatcher-servlet.xml` are the files of OpenNMS 33.1.8 (tag opennms-33.1.8-1,
https://github.com/OpenNMS/opennms, AGPL-3.0). `menubar-vue3.*.js` are its `ui/src/components/Layout/Menubar.vue`
compiled with @vue/compiler-sfc 3.3.4 and 3.5.13 (inline template, production) and esbuild (minified or not), the way a
Vite build compiles it. `theme.jar` is a zip with the stock topology stylesheet inside.
